accuracy_note: 2700chess.com does not publish move-quality/engine-accuracy data for classical games (no PGN eval data on player pages or the leaderboard), so this field is not available from that source.
delta_note: 'Delta' is 2700chess.com's own published live classical rating change versus the last official FIDE rating list (profilePayload.ratings.kinds.classical.live.delta) -- it moves as games complete between monthly official lists, and resets toward 0 when a new official list is published.
games_12mo_site_note: '12m (site)' is 2700chess.com's own published trailing-12-month game count (profilePayload.careerStats.performanceSummary.games) across ALL time controls (classical+rapid+blitz combined) -- it will not match 'Games (12mo classical)', which we compute ourselves from the games list filtered to classical only.
openings_note: Top openings are career-wide totals across all time controls, as published on each player's profile page -- 2700chess.com does not expose a per-game opening field to compute a 12-month/classical-only cut.
progression_delta_note: Rapid Δ (12mo) / Blitz Δ (12mo) are the change in that time control's rating from the first to the last trailing-12-month point in the player's own monthly rating-history chart (profilePayload.chartData's rapid_rating/blitz_rating fields) -- the same chart used for the ELO Progression sparkline, just a different field and no sparkline drawn.
rapid_blitz_games_note: Rapid Games (12mo) / Blitz Games (12mo) are counts of games with format 3 / 2 in the player's own trailing-12-month games list (the same games_in_window list used to build Games (12mo, classical), just counting the other two format codes instead of format 1) -- not a number 2700chess.com publishes directly.
rapid_blitz_note: Rapid ELO/rank and Blitz ELO/rank are 2700chess.com's own published live ratings and world ranks for those time controls (profilePayload.ratings.kinds.rapid/blitz.live) -- sourced from the same page fetch as classical, not a separate scrape. World rank is 2700chess's own overall ranking among rated players for that time control, not something we compute. For female players, 2700chess itself silently scopes 'world rank' to the women's pool rather than the open pool (no field discloses this -- confirmed by inspection), which is why the 'Elite in all time formats' label is split into an open and a women's-pool variant -- see the Labels legend.
seen_better_days_note: 'Seen better days' flags players whose current classical rating is 100+ points below their best-ever classical rating (profilePayload.ratings.kinds.classical.live.best.rating), which 2700chess.com publishes with a date -- shown as a label with the peak rating and month/year on hover.
sites_note: Tournament Sites are the distinct 'site' values from every tracked player's games in the trailing 12-month window (any time control), deduplicated -- e.g. classical, rapid, AND blitz games at the same tournament collapse to one site entry with one merged date range, not three. Coordinates are resolved via Nominatim/OpenStreetMap (best-effort, cached indefinitely once resolved) -- Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. A site 2700chess published with a genuinely ambiguous or unresolvable name (typo, obscure local venue, a country/province instead of a city) still appears in the Sites table with its date range, just without a map pin.
